subject: Follow-up: Pen-test window, DPA clauses & evidence runbook for Treeline Bank
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@treelinebank.com>, Liam Byrne <liam.byrne@treelinebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Pen-test window, DPA clauses & evidence runbook for Treeline Bank

Hi Sam and Liam — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan for security and procurement review.

Key pain points you raised:
- Audit log retention: engineering + compliance need clarity on retention windows and export format (CSV + JSON).
- SOC 2 evidence: you requested a prioritised set of artifacts we can deliver within a 2–4 week window.
- DPA language: your legal team highlighted two DPA clauses (data exportability and subprocessors) that will need review.
- Pen test schedule: Treeline prefers a consolidated window to coordinate internal resources.

Goals we agreed:
1) Give Treeline a trimmed evidence runbook ( prioritized artifacts + owner + expected delivery ETA ).
2) Propose a pen-test window and provide our standard scoping questionnaire.
3) Surface any DPA exceptions early so your legal team can route redlines.

Immediate asks from Redwood (action items):
- We attached a working "treeline-evidence-matrix.xlsx" with initial mapping (SOC 2, audit logs, retention buckets). Please flag items you want prioritized.
- Confirm target log retention: do you need 24 months or longer for audit logs? (You mentioned 18–24 months on the call.)
- Confirm whether pen-test must be run in your EU region or US.

Proposed timeline:
- By Wed 10/13: Treeline confirms retention window + priority artifact list.
- By Fri 10/16: Redwood delivers evidence runbook v1 (technical owners + upload instructions).
- Week of 11/8: proposed pen-test window (subject to your confirmation).

Attachments: treeline-evidence-matrix.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf.

If this aligns, we’ll lock timeline and surface a DocuSign link for a limited-scope DPA amendment (if needed).

Thanks — I’m copying Marissa and Karthik who will own evidence intake and the pen-test logistics.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0184

---
(Attachment stubs: treeline-evidence-matrix.xlsx [17KB, spreadsheet], redwood-soc2-summary.pdf [220KB, PDF])

From: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@treelinebank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pen-test window, DPA clauses & evidence runbook for Treeline Bank

Irene — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Retention: compliance requires 24 months for audit logs; we can discuss exceptions for aggregated metrics but system-level logs are 24 months by policy.
2) SOC 2 artifacts: priority order for us is (a) control monitoring evidence, (b) access reviews for the last 12 months, (c) incident response timeline, (d) encryption at rest key management docs.
3) DPA: our legal team will send a short list of preferred redlines. Two things to highlight now: subprocessors disclosure and a data deletion SLA (30 days) we typically ask for in pilots.
4) Pen test: US window is fine; security prefers non-business-critical week — Nov 8–12 looks plausible. We’ll confirm by Wednesday.

We’ll upload prioritized artifact requests to our vendor portal after we sync with procurement tomorrow. Can Marissa confirm how Redwood prefers to receive large artifacts (SFTP, secure link, or vendor portal)?

Sam Ortega
Sr. InfoSec Manager, Treeline Bank
sam.ortega@treelinebank.com
+1 617-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@treelinebank.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pen-test window, DPA clauses & evidence runbook for Treeline Bank

Thanks Sam — noted on 24 months and artifact priority. Short answers to the upload question and next steps: 

- Preferred intake: secure SFTP for large artifacts + a parallel upload to our secure drive for documents <50MB. We can also accept a link to your procurement portal if you prefer.
- I’ve attached a first-draft "evidence-runbook-v1.md" with owners mapped to each artifact, expected file formats, and required acceptance criteria.
- For the DPA redlines: if your legal sends a short list we will route to legal + security and aim to surface any non-standard asks within 48 business hours.

Action items we’ll take: 
- Marissa: finalize runbook v1 by Fri 10/16 and open a secure SFTP node for Treeline.
- Karthik: stand up a pen-test staging snapshot plan; will share scope doc by 10/15.
- Rishi: I’ve looped Rishi for KMS/key-management artifact pull and SOC2 evidence packaging.

Attachments: evidence-runbook-v1.md (runbook summary).

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Security Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(Attachment stub: evidence-runbook-v1.md [8KB, markdown])

From: Liam Byrne <liam.byrne@treelinebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@treelinebank.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2026 12:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pen-test window, DPA clauses & evidence runbook for Treeline Bank

Marissa — quick note from procurement: Nov 8–12 for the pen test is fine from our scheduling side. We will need the pen test scoping questionnaire by 10/15 to allow internal approvals.

Also, procurement prefers the DPA redlines tracked in a single doc (we’ll provide) rather than multiple email threads. Expect that doc tomorrow morning.

Thanks — Liam
Liam Byrne
Senior Procurement Partner, Treeline Bank
liam.byrne@treelinebank.com

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@treelinebank.com>, Liam Byrne <liam.byrne@treelinebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pen-test window, DPA clauses & evidence runbook for Treeline Bank

Perfect — thanks everyone. Confirming the shared plan:

- You’ll send the DPA redline doc tomorrow (Liam/procurement).
- Treeline confirms 24-month retention for system-level audit logs.
- Redwood will: deliver runbook v1 by 10/16 (Marissa), provide pen-test scope doc by 10/15 (Karthik), and publish KMS/SOC2 artifacts (Rishi).
- Tentative pen-test: Nov 8–12; we’ll mark that as reserved and send a final confirmation + contact list when the scope is agreed.

I’ll open a HubSpot task and link the secure SFTP node in the runbook once created. If anyone needs a calendar invite for the pen-test planning sync, reply here with preferred times and we’ll schedule.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to onboarding.

Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

(Links: https://app.redwood.com/deals/DL-7834, secure SFTP to be shared in runbook)
